snippet.title: Guinea Pig Gunner Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Guinea Pig Gunner 🐹🎮👾

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3996660/Guinea_Pig_Gunner/

Run-and-gun action platformer with boomer shooter DNA.

Fluid movement meets heavy arsenal meets puzzle platforming in this new arcade action adventure.

Play as Gunner, a cyborg guinea pig armed with a flamethrower and a teleportation gun. Defend your home world from reptilian invaders bent on colonizing your planet in service to their false AI god.

GPG mixes classic 16-bit run-and-gun action with movement shooter bullet hell chaos.

Try the demo now on Steam, and add it to your wishlist today!
